name: m1-14-halal-legal-map
title: Every halal-economy instrument already exists on paper; the two that move money — Art 192 and sukuk daerah — sit blocked or unused.
sourceLine: Source: UU 11/2006 [710]; Baitul Mal Aceh Utara, Sep 2024 [707]; RRI, PMK 114/2025 [708]; OJK, POJK 10/2024 [704]; Antara, Jun 2025 [705]; MKRI, 13 Nov 2025 [706]; KADIN Aceh via Pikiran Rakyat [709].
